To Whom It May Concern,  

I have had the pleasure of observing Moussa Keita’s work as a Staff Backend Engineer at GlobalTech Solutions Inc. over the past three years. While our interactions have been occasional, I have followed his contributions to key initiatives, particularly in architecture and system reliability.  

Moussa’s strength lies in his ability to design resilient, scalable systems. He led the migration of GlobalTech’s core billing platform to microservices, reducing latency by 40% and improving fault tolerance. His work on Kubernetes clusters, which he owns end-to-end, has minimized downtime by 30% through automated scaling and proactive monitoring. He also spearheaded the adoption of REST APIs for a cross-functional integration project, resulting in a 25% reduction in manual coordination between teams.  

A standout example is his refactoring of GlobalTech’s PostgreSQL database layer. By optimizing queries and indexing strategies, he boosted read performance by 50%, enabling the team to handle a 3x increase in transaction volume without additional hardware. His Python scripts for automating schema migrations cut deployment time by two hours per release. These efforts reflect his deep technical rigor and ability to align infrastructure with business needs.  

Moussa is a reliable collaborator with a meticulous work ethic. He mentors junior engineers on Go best practices and consistently prioritizes long-term system stability over short-term gains. His contributions have been instrumental in maintaining GlobalTech’s operational excellence.  

I wholeheartedly recommend Moussa for any opportunity where his expertise in scalable systems and leadership in complex architectures can add value.  

Sincerely,  
[Recommender’s Name]  
[Recommender’s Title]  
GlobalTech Solutions Inc.
